goal: Complete role-scoped native and external orchestration, TypeSafe checkpoints, and dashboard measurements.
constraints: Preserve existing user configuration and prior uncommitted work.
Native tools remain owned by the parent runtime; external execution never raises its permissions.
Do not claim access to private reasoning; enforce observable seams and require explicit checkpoints for internal judgments.
Use compact role packets, bounded concurrency, isolated editing worktrees and redacted telemetry.

non_goals.description: Do not change target application source, deploy regional applications, or modify credentials.

acceptance.criterion: Dispatcher regression and native/external bridge tests pass
Decision enforcement, configuration and outcome tests pass
Dashboard aggregation and existing service tests pass
Native and installed external workers produce verified artifacts and telemetry visible in the running dashboard
